cues: For an aromatic ether, the same logic.
Sodium phenoxide plus iodomethane gives anisole.
But methoxide plus chlorobenzene gives nothing at all.
The ring carbon is s p two, its bond to chlorine has partial double bond character, and the ring itself blocks any backside attack.
